name: God Provides
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign provider of all our needs, sustaining His creation from the smallest raven to His children. As seen in Genesis 9:3 and Job 38:41, God grants provision for every living creature, and Psalm 34:10 assures that those who seek the Lord will lack no good thing. Jesus encourages believers not to worry about daily necessities, highlighting in Matthew 6:31 and Luke 12:24 how God cares even for birds, promising that He will surely provide for those who trust in Him, as emphasized in Matthew 7:11.
